question: Can an extractor recover a grounded structural descriptor from short real external technical/scientific source spans while explicitly leaving application-specific mapping/precondition coordinates unknown?

sources.title: Maximum Flow in Directed Planar Graphs with Vertex Capacities
sources.span: In this paper we present an O(n log n) algorithm for finding a maximum flow in a directed planar graph.

sources.title: Operational Semantics of Resolution and Productivity in Horn Clause Logic
sources.span: This paper presents a study of operational and type-theoretic properties of different resolution strategies in Horn clause logic.

sources.title: Quantities, Dimensions and Dimensional Analysis
sources.span: Formal definitions of quantities, quantity spaces, dimensions and dimension groups are introduced.

sources.title: Reachability problems for communicating finite state machines
sources.span: The paper deals with the verification of reachability properties in a commonly used state transition model of communication protocols.

sources.title: Approximate Deadline-Scheduling with Precedence Constraints
sources.span: We consider the classic problem of scheduling a set of n jobs non-preemptively on a single machine.

sources.title: Derivation of Generalized Equations for the Predictive Value of Sequential Screening Tests
sources.span: Using Bayes' Theorem, we derive generalized equations to determine the positive and negative predictive value of screening tests undertaken sequentially.

development_rule: The six spans are a source-grounding pilot only. They may develop schema/parsing but cannot support a broad natural-domain result.
fresh_successor_if_schema_works: freeze a larger disjoint set of real source/target excerpts before model outcomes, with exact source locators/spans, independent annotation and a downstream transfer decision
hard_constraints: span SHA must match before extraction
extractor must not invent application-specific mapping or preconditions absent from the span
source family/QoI/boundary descriptor must cite the exact span
